principles: PRE_CERT is admission, not another test: heavy suites stay exactly as they are, they just cannot start without a current window.
CertificationWindow is a separate owner from Review Inventory; inventory completeness must never become certification authority.
Keep current strict freshness: related story-owned drift fail-closes; never rewrite stored hashes or treat whole-tree drift as fresh.
Every process fact that changes a gate must be signed, registered, and consumed by a handler, not only by prompt text.
Refuse early with one blocker code and one Next command; do not start a 30-45 minute suite to discover the same fact later.
drivers: B-9812-shaped stories rerun expensive matrices on unconverged candidates.
B-3f3d already froze REVIEW inventory but explicitly is not PRE_CERT.
done_required_validate and validate --full are already official entrypoints and must be the choke points.

options.name: A: Independent CertificationWindow owner plus heavy-entrypoint choke
pros: Matches the U-01 split and B-3f3d's stated authority boundary.
Can consume inventory, merge-main, and clean-tree facts without mixing them into one receipt.
Invalidation of the window does not reopen or rewrite inventory receipts.
cons: Adds a second signed artifact family and another operator command surface.
DEV must merge unfinished B-3f3d or fixture its public API.

options.name: B: Extend review-inventory receipts to also authorize heavy certification
pros: Fewer artifacts and one finalize command.
cons: Contradicts B-3f3d's inventory-completeness-only authority and authorizesTest=false.
A later inventory bug would silently weaken or over-grant certification.
Forces this story to reopen B-3f3d's signature domain.

options.name: C: Prompt-only PRE_CERT plus done_prepare hints
cons: Hosts can still launch done_required_validate whenever they want.
Does not produce the required [pre_cert_window_required] refusal.

chosen: A: Independent CertificationWindow owner plus heavy-entrypoint choke
rationale: U-01b exists because B-3f3d refused to become PRE_CERT. A separate window owner can consume a FINALIZED inventory plus done_prepare merge/clean facts, choke only official heavy entrypoints, and invalidate on source mutation without rewriting inventory or relaxing freshness.

preMortem.scenario: B-3f3d APIs are missing on this worktree and implementers stub PRE_CERT to always admit
preMortem.trigger: story/B-1e1f was branched from main; review-inventory-epoch.ts is only in .worktrees/B-3f3d
preMortem.consequence: done_required_validate runs on unconverged candidates and the story ships a no-op gate
preMortem.mitigation: DEV first merge or vendor the B-3f3d public functions; admit must fail closed when inventory APIs or a FINALIZED receipt are absent; smoke proves the refuse path without those fixtures

preMortem.scenario: Routine validate or REVIEW preflight is misclassified as heavy and every reviewer round is blocked
preMortem.trigger: The choke wraps createVerifierHandlers.validate without distinguishing --full from --channel/--lint
preMortem.consequence: REVIEW cannot produce evidence; U-01b becomes slower than the problem it solves
preMortem.mitigation: Explicit allowlist: only done_required_validate, validate --full, and doneRequiredCommands are heavy; add a negative smoke that routine validate still starts

preMortem.scenario: Window artifact is written outside story metadata and auto-committed, moving HEAD
preMortem.trigger: New certification-window.json is stored under .lattice/ but not registered as materialHash-exclude or story metadata
preMortem.consequence: Admitting the window invalidates the same inventory/delivery evidence it just consumed
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the signed window under the story active dir and let autoCommitStoryMetadata own it, or register a non-authoritative path in RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_REGISTRY with materialHash exclude and no extra HEAD-moving commit

preMortem.scenario: Source mutation is allowed and old DONE-required receipts are rebound to the new hash
preMortem.trigger: Implementer treats window identity as advisory and copies the B-914f reuse path
preMortem.consequence: post-cert source commits keep a PASS; fail-closed freshness is lost
preMortem.mitigation: Invalidate on storyFilesHash/material change; receipts keep original hashes; heavy reuse must require an ADMITTED window whose frozen identity still matches
